parsed_json.explanation: Time complexity is O(N * K log K + N * V), where N is the number of elements in the input array, K is the average number of keys per object, and V is the average size of the JSON string representation. Sorting keys takes O(K log K) per object, and JSON.stringify takes O(V). Space complexity is O(N * V) to store the set of unique JSON string keys and the result array.
